info.title: Open-Meteo Geocoding
info.description: Free, keyless place-name search over GeoNames. Turns a name the user typed into candidate places with coordinates, country, region, time zone and population. Same provider as the air-quality API but a different host, so it is its own namespace.

get.summary: Find places by name, with coordinates
get.description: Returns up to `count` places whose name matches, most relevant first. A bare name is ambiguous — 'Lisbon' is a capital in Portugal and a village in Ohio — so show the user `country` and `admin1` and let them pick, or prefer the most populous candidate. When nothing matches, `results` is ABSENT from the response rather than empty.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The place name to search for, e.g. 'Lisbon'. Two or more characters; postal codes also match in some countries.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the returned names, e.g. 'en'.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code to restrict the search to one country, e.g. 'PT'.

200.description: Candidate places. Each result carries `name`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `country`, `country_code`, `admin1` (region or state), `timezone`, `population` and `feature_code` (PPLC is a capital, PPLA a regional seat, PPL a populated place).
